verdict: INCONCLUSIVE re-test: this simple (x,c)->Y regression toy did NOT reproduce the baseline free-code SCRAMBLE -- the free embedding stays linearly legible even at D=2 and under a random-MLP coupling (linear ~0.93-1.0). So it cannot test the AlphaLudo refinement. Instructive: the scramble is NOT a generic property of (free code + nonlinear map); it needs the specific harder task structure of scripts 35/48 (contrastive / physics-trajectory), where a free code with abundant clean data does not trivially linearize. The AlphaLudo refinement stands on THEIR validated test (script-35 reproduction + a positive control matching our 0.22); a definitive in-our-harness re-test (script-35 World with linear-vs-generic coupling, as they did) is the clean follow-up.
